name: ad/carousel
description: Five to seven same-ratio slides: a hook with a swipe cue, context and proof slides (text plus an optional capture that runs off the slide edge), and a last slide that is only the ask, the brand and the CTA. Content in the centre 80%; every slide carries its number.

slides.doc: 5-7 slides: [{ kicker?, headline, body?, image? }]. Slide 1 is the hook (headline ≤ 7 words); the last slide's headline is the ask above the CTA (its body and image are ignored).

cta.doc: The CTA pill on the last slide (the accent).

url.doc: Short domain under the CTA, optional.

swipeLabel.doc: Label of the swipe cue on slide 1, in the ad's language.

imageZoom.doc: Crop zoom into captures (1 = fitted by cover).
